description: This file defines the Snapshotter class used for capturing and managing page/frame snapshots within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for starting, resetting, capturing snapshots, and handling frame hierarchy annotations.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: Manages page/frame snapshots, including starting, resetting, capturing, and annotating frames for the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the snapshotter and begins snapshot capturing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the snapshotter state in all frames.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Prepares the snapshotter for reuse by removing scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up the snapshotter, including adding event listeners and init scripts.

methods.name: _captureFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a specific frame.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures snapshots for all frames in a page.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles page events to annotate frame hierarchy.

methods.name: _annotateFrameHierarchy
methods.description: Adds iframe annotations to the frame hierarchy.
